episodes.title: A Prophecy That Killed 39 People In One Night
episodes.description:
In 1954, a small group watched their predicted apocalypse fail to happen — and walked away believing it MORE, not less. This is the true story that gave psychology the term "cognitive dissonance," and it's just the beginning.

In this video, we break down history's most famous failed prophecies — from the Great Disappointment of 1844, to Y2K, to Harold Camping's double Rapture prediction, to the tragedy of Heaven's Gate — and the psychological mechanism that explains why so many people didn't walk away when the evidence told them to.
